provenance.descriptorKind: derived v0.18.10 declaration compatibility descriptors, not original execution manifests
limitations: Original screen.json, stage run.json, archived INI files, runtime receipts and native-preflight proofs were not supplied. Derived descriptors check recorded declaration compatibility; they are not recovered original manifests.

Recorded profile/registry hashes, starting armies, openings, strengths, search settings and applied value policies match the reconstructed declarations. Engine names and profile hashes do not attest the executable or its native tables.
Moves and terminal outcomes were not independently replayed. No new matches, engine searches, outcome-fitted material values or individual-piece Elo were produced.
Both studies use thirty-two related fixed opening cases from the reused casebook. Conditional ranges do not make each game an independent starting position.

evaluationAudit.policy: The new two-point QcC treatment and fresh QsN control share 3738/4155 MG/EG. NDmW / NDmF and fresh NDmK share 1203/1352. BsW2 / BsWsnN / BsW3 and fresh Free Boar share 1782/1756. QcC retains its earlier one-point movement but changes purchase context and search prior, not a pure price-effect comparison. Each army buys one two-point upgrade; the three L2 references retain their frozen priors. Values apply to all six engine tables for both colors; these are controlled search settings, not estimated material values. No earlier scored journals are pooled.
